diagnosis.overall_diagnosis: Only Q5 failed because runner_up_run_ids were sorted by ranking (quality/efficiency) instead of ascending run_id as the task spec requires. The required skill reflow-machine-maintenance-guidance is the task-mandated skill and should carry explicit instruction on Q5 output ordering. The reflow-profile-compliance-toolkit skill focuses on thermocouple/handbook computations (Q1-Q4) which passed, so it is not implicated.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The skill guides the full Q1–Q5 workflow but does not explicitly state that for Q5 the runner_up_run_ids array must be sorted ascending by run_id (the verifier enforces lexicographic sort). The agent sorted runner-ups by ranking order instead, causing the only test failure. The skill should also reinforce the general output-formatting rule from the task spec (sort arrays by run_id/board_family/board_id ascending) and apply it to all list fields, including runner_up_run_ids.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Add an explicit Q5 (best run per board_family) section that: (1) selects best_run_id by quality then efficiency (e.g., fp_yield_pct desc, then boards_per_min desc, with deterministic tie-break by run_id ascending); (2) EXPLICITLY requires runner_up_run_ids to be sorted ascending by run_id (lexicographic string sort), NOT by ranking score. Add a general 'Output formatting rules' note stating: all arrays in output JSON (including nested arrays like runner_up_run_ids) must be sorted ascending by run_id / board_family / board_id per the task spec, floats rounded to 2 decimals, use null for missing values. Include a small example showing runner_up_run_ids = sorted([...]) in ascending run_id order.
